sections: L. PILOT DESIGN — L-2, L-3, L-4

scopeStatement: This schema describes the bounded outcome-hidden pilot's reported result. It measures contract-execution agreement between two independent coders. It does NOT measure, and must not be read as, any Environment determination or predictive claim.

measured.note: CORR4 §L-3. Every item below is a required reportable measurement of the bounded pilot.

items.name: stratification agreement
items.unit: per-(fact, D) mark comparison across all 13 D rows
items.note: Stratification is explicitly part of the measured process and is NOT claimed neutral.

items.name: join / relationInstance binding agreement
reported: perJoin[] (relationInstanceId_A, relationInstanceId_B, organizationalObjectRef, linkageEvidence{class, identifier}, agreement)

notMeasured.note: CORR4 §L-3. These are outside the bounded pilot and must not appear as pilot result fields.
notMeasured.rationale: The bounded pilot is outcome-hidden and terminates at the mechanism-measurement layer. Environment determination is HEDC's separate downstream act (CORR4 §K-5, §M).

disagreementTaxonomy.note: CORR4 §L-4. Exactly four categories. No fifth category exists.

categories.meaning: one coder applied the frozen rule incorrectly; the rule itself is adequate
categories.route: correct only the affected cell; re-IV and re-run that cell

categories.meaning: the frozen definition admits two readings that produce different lawful results
categories.route: correct only the affected cell; re-IV and re-run that cell

categories.meaning: the fact records an organizational behavior that no frozen M represents
categories.route: → schema review (§M); separately authorized, versioned correction/re-IV path

categories.meaning: the §G/§H binding grammar cannot lawfully bind the fact to any M or component
categories.route: → schema review (§M); separately authorized, versioned correction/re-IV path

disagreementTaxonomy.repairRoute: CORR4 §L-4 and §M: disagreement-driven repair is a separately authorized, versioned correction/re-IV path, never opportunistic tuning to selected corpus facts. Only affected cells are corrected, re-IV'd and re-run.

postCodingCoverageReport.note: CORR4 §L:1041 (Owner Option A). This is a POST-CODING report on which execution paths were actually exercised. It is not a sampling rule and not a pre-hoc quota.
postCodingCoverageReport.timing: AFTER analytical coding; never before or during sampling

coveragePathGapSemantics.meansOnly: the bounded pilot did not exercise that execution path

sampleAccountingRequired.note: The fixed pre-coding sample and its realized shortfalls must be reported alongside the measurements.
